attempts.summary: Built a fresh 3-member etcd 3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (etcd wasn't previously installed), loaded it with application keys under /app/*, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir), removed the dead member from the cluster via etcdctl, added a new member for node3, and restarted etcd on node3 with initial-cluster-state=existing so it rejoined and caught up via raft. Verified 3/3 healthy members and all application keys intact. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot_id and post-restart cluster/data health at each step.
